note:
738 -> 651: odoo/orm, -87. Re-derived at ea183558595; the base was 738 there and at the two commits before it, and the delta held. Not a sweep -- four structural causes, each one edit.

1. UNDECLARED CLASS STATE, -27. Six attributes that registration.py and
   runtime/registry.py assign onto model classes and BaseModel never declared:
   _setup_done__, _base_classes__, _model_classes__, _setup_in_progress__,
   _init_attrs_in_progress__, _inherit_module. Declared in
   models/mixins/_metadata.py, the composition's declared metadata holder, as
   annotations only. An undeclared attribute makes every read site look like a
   bug to the checker.

   Two of the six MUST stay annotation-only, and the comment there says so:
   registration sets them, reads them back through model_cls.__dict__.get(...)
   and then deletes them. A value here would land in BaseModel.__dict__, where
   the delete cannot reach it and the guard would read the inherited value
   forever.

   _base_classes__ is tuple[type[BaseModel], ...] and _model_classes__ is
   tuple[type, ...]; the asymmetry is real. The first holds model classes and
   its consumers read _inherit/_description/_table off them. The second holds
   mro() entries with no pool, which includes mixins, and every consumer already
   guards with isinstance(cls, MetaModel) or reads __dict__ directly.

2. Environment.uid, -5. Annotated int; the ORM has never meant that. Widened to
   int | None on BOTH __new__ and the class attribute -- the parameter alone is
   worse, leaving self.uid's assignment failing against the attribute.
   tests/test_environment_uid.py pins None, int, bool-rejected and an opaque
   placeholder by name, so the runtime contract is wider still, and the
   isinstance(uid, int) guard that keeps a placeholder env from becoming the
   transaction default now reads redundant and carries a comment saying why.

3. FIELD MIXIN STUBS, -11. _FieldDescriptionMixin read six members declared on
   Field rather than on _FieldStubs: is_column, base_field, readonly, search,
   falsy_value_label, description_attrs. Added to the stub block that exists for
   exactly this, mirroring how column_type is handled there.

4. MISSING VARIABLE ANNOTATIONS, -28, over 25 production sites plus one TypeVar
   bound: BaseDate[T] is now BaseDate[T: date], which is what its only two
   subclasses are. That clears .year/.month/.day/.isocalendar/.timetuple/
   .isoweekday; .hour/.minute/.second stay, guarded at runtime by
   'if self.is_datetime' where no annotation can follow.

WHAT WAS DELIBERATELY NOT SILENCED, so the remaining 635 in odoo/orm is not all
debt:

  * iteration.py's comparison dunders (10) duck-type inside
    try/except AttributeError on purpose. isinstance would be a behaviour change
    on the most-used object in the framework; ten type: ignore lines would be
    noise.
  * decorators.py (7) stamps marker attributes onto functions. The type system
    cannot express that without a Protocol functions do not satisfy.
  * MetaModel.pool is Registry | None and that is CORRECT and load-bearing: a
    model DEFINITION class has no pool, and that is precisely how registration
    tells a definition class from a registry class. The 11 sites reading
    model_cls.pool want narrowing asserts in registry bootstrap, which deserves
    its own change.
  * The two _RequestUIDLike diagnostics in tests/test_environment_uid.py are the
    only place the runtime contract is visibly wider than the annotation.

MYPY DELTAS DO NOT COMPOSE THE WAY pyfunclen's DO. Measured twice on this
change: an earlier -14 from the same scope contributed ZERO on top of the
odoo/modules work, because its diagnostics were downstream of the same
_ModuleLoader.env annotation; a later -5 was additive. Union-measure; never
subtract.

Measured per section 9.3 in a detached worktree at ea183558595 with mypy==2.3.0
and nothing else installed, --no-incremental: 738 with nothing applied, 651 with
only this change's files copied in.
